title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to S&P 500 from “The Fed raises by a half point or more on December 9”

A half-point move against 6-7% priced would lift front-end yields by roughly 15-20bp and signal a faster path. On Nov 10, 2026, when hot CPI moved the 2-year 17bp, the S&P 500 lost 0.4% in a day; a surprise at the meeting itself, with Waller's 'shock' framing, is larger. I put the S&P 1.5% below where a quarter point leaves it.
